This is likely DOSIDLE.EXE waiting for timer interrupts that aren't firing properly under QEMU 8.2.2. The screen is black because DOS hasn't written visible text yet (only control characters). We need to either fix timer interrupt delivery or create a modified boot image without DOSIDLE.",
  "plan": "First try `-icount shift=auto` to fix timer interrupt timing. If that doesn't work, create a qcow2 overlay image, mount it, remove DOSIDLE from AUTOEXEC.BAT, and boot from the modified overlay while still keeping the original image immutable.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "kill $(cat /tmp/qemu.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock /tmp/qemu.pid /tmp/qemu-debug.log
qemu-system-i386 \
  -M pc-i440fx-2.0 \
  -hda /app/isos/win311.img \
  -snapshot \
  -m 32 \
  -vga cirrus \
  -rtc base=localtime \
  -boot c \
  -icount shift=auto \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -daemonize \
  -pidfile /tmp/qemu.pid

python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import socket, time, re
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r1 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip1 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r1)
time.sleep(1)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r2 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip2 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r2)
hlt = 'HLT=1' in r1
print(f"EIP 1: {eip1.group(1) if eip1 else 'N/A'}, EIP 2: {eip2.group(1) if eip2 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"Progressing: {eip1 and eip2 and eip1.group(1) != eip2.group(1)}, HLT: {hlt}")
s.sendall(b'screendump /tmp/qemu-screen8.ppm\n')
time.sleep(0.5)
s.recv(4096)
s.close()
PYEOF
python3 -c "
with open('/tmp/qemu-screen8.ppm','rb') as f:
    f.readline(); dims = f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); data = f.read()
    w, h = map(int, dims.split())
    non_black = sum(1 for i in range(0, len(data), 3) if data[i] > 30 or data[i+1] > 30 or data[i+2] > 30)
    print(f'Dimensions: {w}x{h}, Non-black: {non_black} ({100*non_black/(w*h):.1f}%)')
"
",
      "duration": 25.0
    }
  ]
